name: California
seasonNote: Enter from the Arizona desert into San Diego and work south-to-north up the state — the route never doubles back, so the coast runs in one clean line. The coast itself is mild year-round; time the Sierra (Yosemite's Tioga Road, the high country) for late spring through fall.
summary: The whole Golden State, south to north: San Diego and the SoCal desert, Los Angeles and the Central Coast, the Sierra parks at Sequoia and Yosemite, the Monterey coast and Big Sur, San Francisco and the capital, the wine country and Lake Tahoe, and the volcanic north through Lassen, Mendocino, and the tallest trees on earth at Redwood.
